facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Anne came to Green Gables. She was different from other children. Being different is special. Anne was different.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Anne Shirley was an orphan girl with red hair and freckles. Marilla and Matthew wanted a boy to help on their farm. But Anne arrived by mistake — and she was nothing like they expected! Anne was different: she talked a lot and had a huge imagination. Anne was different. Being different turned out to be Anne's greatest strength.
facts.Page story text 3 (draft, teacher check: Anne Shirley arrived at Green Gables with nothing but a worn suitcase and an extraordinary imagination. Marilla and Matthew Cuthbert had specifically requested a boy from the orphanage to help with farm work. When they discovered the mistake, Marilla wanted to send Anne back immediately. But there was something undeniably captivating about this talkative red-haired girl with sparkling eyes. Anne was different. However, being different in a small, traditional community like Avonlea was not always easy. Because Anne did not fit the mold of what people expected, she often felt like an outsider. Yet it was precisely her uniqueness that would eventually win everyone's hearts and change their world.
